title: The Crooked Signpost
text: A signpost at a fork, leaning, its arms pointing every way at once. Every arm reads HOME, in the same careful letters. Someone has carved a mark on the post for each traveller who passed. There are a great many marks, and no footprints going on.

options.label: The quickest scouts the left way home, and hopes it means what it says.

outcomes.text: A shortcut, and a good one, and no marks on the post for it.
A shortcut to something hungry, waiting patiently at the end of it.

options.label: The party keeps right, and trusts nothing the post says.

outcomes.text: The long way, and an honest one, and it never once says HOME.

options.label: Pull up the post and burn it, so that it leads no one else astray.

outcomes.text: The paths straighten out. Something on them is very cross about it.
